decisions.initiation: Use one composite monthly prescription hazard per coarse source group until reach, discussion and choice are separately observed. Keep operational reach scorecard diagnostic.
decisions.history: Prior oral exposure and opt-in consent are overlapping flags on current treatment states.
decisions.retention: Separate early, year1 and mature hazards; do not fit one exponential to a single checkpoint.
decisions.pricing: Link access and realized net price; reflect IR-to-XR recruitment economics without assuming bundling discounts.
decisions.forecast_gate: Missing current treatment partition, PHVS capture, paid conversion, mature survival, net prices and geography preclude a defensible central TAM/peak estimate.
